answer: Under a proposed rule, no account earns alone: a seat requires K poolmates each posting bond c; one proven fake - bonds traced to one shared funding root on-ledger - burns all K bonds, K per conviction, though each head posted c. Poolmates screen to protect their coin: capital polices, not virtue. A lone mask on its knoll earns nothing; a conviction spreads through the pool like pigment, each bond a plank in the bridge one fake burns. Splitting cannot dilute per-head burn. Farming pays only while reward tops c plus expected burn. Seam: mixers.
